name: kotlet
description: Connects Codex to your Kotlet kitchen: recipes, ingredients, pantry, shopping list, and meal plans over the hosted Kotlet MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Import recipes into Kotlet and plan meals from your own kitchen data.
interface.longDescription: Kotlet keeps your recipes, pantry, meal plans, and shopping list in one place. This plugin connects Codex to the hosted Kotlet MCP server over OAuth and adds an import-recipe skill that extracts a recipe from a page, video, or pasted text, checks it is not already saved, resolves every ingredient against the shared catalogue, and saves it once.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this recipe is already in my Kotlet kitchen.
What is on my Kotlet shopping list?
